text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, on the way back from accompanying
Admire Groove to get her horseshoes maintained...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: That's—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: You there! Don't chase after the front-runner recklessly!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
First, maintain your pace!
Let's prioritize finishing this distance!

text_block_list.name: Alv's Orphanage Child A
text_block_list.text: Yup, "Teacher"!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under the overpass, several children
seemed to be receiving coaching from Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Just as I thought I'd seen it before—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
She really is a child from the same facility.
Why would she... need guidance from me?

text_block_list.name: Alv's Orphanage Child A
text_block_list.text: Big sis Alv!

text_block_list.name: Child at Alv's Facility B
text_block_list.text:
Right now, "Teacher" is watching my running form!
I've gotten way faster than before, you know!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're achieving splendid results.
choice_data_list: Why are you with that kid from Alv's facility...?
Why are you with a child from Alv's facility...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Actually... I saw these girls training on their own in their own style earlier.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I can't join the club, but I want to be just like big sis Alv."
...Hearing that, I really wanted to help her out if I could♪

text_block_list.name: Child at Alv's Facility C
text_block_list.text:
You know what? They said I've got real talent!
If I keep working hard like this, making my debut isn't just a dream!

text_block_list.name: Child at Alv's Facility B
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! She trains us real hard,
so sometimes she feels more like
a 'boss' than a 'teacher'~!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...
Cesario-san, could you come over here for a second?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
You...
How involved do you intend to get with those girls?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: You have your own training to do, don't you? Giving false hope like that is—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
No... if they wish for it, I will gladly do as much as needed.
I intend to see this through to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"In the future, I will become a foundation to guide many children.
And that... includes these girls as well."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So that my pupil may fulfill her dream---
As her "teacher," I will guide her there.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
――……
I'm going home.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Push off the ground and drive that force forward—
Only tense up for that single instant.
Yes, just like that!
choice_data_list: Looks like Cesario and the others are working hard.
Looks like Cesario and the others are working hard, huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
You over there, your shoulders are raised and your neck is stiff!
Relax and stabilize your form!
choice_data_list: Oh, you're at it again today, huh
Ah, they're at it again today.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Alve-san!
Did you come to watch me?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: No. I was just passing by.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Um... could you please take a look at this?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'm compiling their physical data, future dreams,
and training plans to achieve those dreams,
one by one.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...
An entire volume of this content for each person?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
For now, yes. I believe there will be even more
as we go through trial and error in the future.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: As a "teacher," this contract is proof that we will walk together, three-legged, all the way to the goal.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...
—You're not lying, are you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ! Of course...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
Now that you've talked big, don't you dare back down.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...!
I swear, I will fulfill my pledge!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So... I have a suggestion.
To prove my pledge, would you mind coming by to check on me once in a while, Alv-san?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I mean, if an older girl they look up to comes to watch, I'm sure these kids will try even harder♪

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Not you too.
choice_data_list: I'm sure there's something Alv can learn from this too
I'm looking forward to your future!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cesario's father is an active Trainer.
Her mother works as an instructor at a youth training club—
choice_data_list: You'll gain know-how different from what you'd learn at the academy.
You'll be able to learn things you wouldn't at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well...
I suppose you have a point there, but...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Groove-san...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Only when I feel like it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward—the two of them were occasionally seen
together, watching the children run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the distant future, under the watchful eyes of both of them,
the talents of these children will truly blossom—
choice_data_list: I can't wait for that day to come.
I can't wait for that day to come!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...You're getting ahead of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ I would truly love for that to happen—
no, I will definitely make it a reality.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward—the two of them were occasionally seen
together, watching the children run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I hoped that this bond would last forever—
a heartwarming thought, and a sincere wish."
